description: Deploy Docker image with pyarrow dependency to ECR
steps: Verify Dockerfile includes prediction-data[backfill] which provides pyarrow
Run ./scripts/push_ecr.sh to build and push Docker image to ECR
Verify new image is available in ECR with updated timestamp
Trigger a test Silver catchup task to verify pyarrow import works

description: Verify Silver EventBridge schedules are correctly configured
steps: Confirm silver-polymarket-trades-prod schedule is ENABLED (every 10 min)
Confirm silver-polymarket-markets-prod schedule is ENABLED (every 30 min)
Confirm silver-polymarket-events-prod schedule is ENABLED (every 30 min)
Confirm silver-maintain-compact-prod schedule is ENABLED (daily 04:00 UTC)
Confirm silver-maintain-full-prod schedule is ENABLED (weekly Sunday 04:00 UTC)
Confirm Kalshi schedules are DISABLED (scaffolded only, no Bronze data yet)

description: Verify Silver processing pipeline processes Bronze data correctly
steps: Run prediction-data silver catchup --platform polymarket --entity trades --dry-run
Run actual catchup and verify it completes without errors
Check CloudWatch logs for successful Silver processing messages
Verify new data appears in Silver trades table for recent dates

description: Verify Silver Iceberg maintenance jobs work correctly
steps: Run prediction-data silver compact --table polymarket/trades --dry-run
Run prediction-data silver expire-snapshots --table polymarket/trades --dry-run
Check CloudWatch logs for recent maintenance job runs
Verify maintenance schedules are triggering ECS tasks successfully

description: Create scripts/verify_silver_operational.py to check Silver layer health
steps: Create verification script similar to verify_bronze_operational.py
Check all Silver schedules exist with correct configuration
Check Silver table data freshness (trades should be within 1 day)
Check recent CloudWatch logs for errors
Report overall Silver operational status

description: End-to-end validation of Silver layer operational status
steps: Run python scripts/verify_silver_operational.py and verify all checks pass
Query Silver polymarket.trades table and verify data freshness
Query Silver polymarket.markets table and verify recent updates
Query Silver polymarket.events table and verify recent updates
Document current Silver data coverage and confirm no gaps
